title: Free to Look, Free to Reason: Simple LLM Harnesses Outdiagnose Hand-Crafted Root Cause Analysis Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.35767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) of microservice failures has attracted many LLM agents whose investigation is hand-crafted, through standard operating procedures, fixed stages and role agents. Each is evaluated on its own data against few baselines, so it is unknown whether this design beats letting a capable model investigate on its own. We compare three simple harnesses that prescribe none of the model's calls (one call over an evidence package, a SQL agent and the Codex coding agent) with five published LLM RCA agents and with statistical and causal methods on RCAtlas, 90 validated cases from eight public datasets, across six models and three reasoning efforts. The simple harnesses are the most accurate (PR@1 65-77% on three mid-tier models), ahead of the published agents (16-53%) and the non-LLM methods (6-39%), on every model on which both families were run. translated_title: 自由观察，自由推理：简单的LLM运行框架在根因分析诊断上超越手工构建的智能体
translated_abstract: 微服务故障的根因分析（RCA）吸引了众多LLM智能体，这些智能体的调查过程是通过标准操作流程、固定阶段和角色智能体等方式手工构建的。由于每个智能体都在各自的数据上仅针对少量基线进行评估，因此尚不清楚这种设计是否优于让一个能力强大的模型自主开展调查。我们在RCAtlas基准上比较了三种不预设任何模型调用方式的简单框架（对证据包的单次调用、SQL智能体以及Codex编码智能体）、五个已发表的LLM RCA智能体，以及统计方法和因果方法。RCAtlas包含来自八个公开数据集的90个经验证的案例，覆盖六个模型和三种推理努力程度。在两个系列方法都运行过的每一个模型上，简单框架都是最准确的（在三个中端模型上PR@1达到65-77%），领先于已发表的智能体（16-53%）和非LLM方法（6-39%）。已发表的智能体在程序中将十分之一到全部的模型调用固定下来（摘要原文在此处中断）。
tldr: 该论文发现，不预设调查流程、让模型自由观察和推理的简单LLM框架，在微服务故障根因分析上比手工设计的LLM智能体和非LLM统计因果方法诊断得更准确。
en_tdlr: Simple LLM harnesses that leave the model free to investigate outperform hand-crafted root cause analysis agents and non-LLM statistical/causal methods on microservice failure diagnosis.
